# Types

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Common types for zlibc and the zuzu kernel.

```c
#include <types.h>
```

## Types

| Type | Definition | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="handle"></a>`Handle` | `int32_t` | Index into the Space's object table. |
| <a id="spid"></a>`Spid` | `int32_t` | Space ID. |
| <a id="tid"></a>`Tid` | `int32_t` | Task ID. |
| <a id="tick"></a>`Tick` | `uint64_t` | [Tick](#tick) from the CPU timer. |
| <a id="physaddr"></a>`PhysAddr` | `uintptr_t` | Physical address in integer form. |

| <a id="duration"></a>`Duration` | `uint32_t` | [Duration](#duration) of time (usually in ms). |
| <a id="time"></a>`Time` | `uint64_t` | [Time](#time), measured in ticks. |
| <a id="marker"></a>`Marker` | `uint32_t` | Stamped value of a distinct object. |
| <a id="ticket"></a>`Ticket` | `uint32_t` | Index into a port's held callers queue. |
| <a id="eventword"></a>`EventWord` | `uint32_t` | Bits delivered on an event wakeup. |

| Name | Value | Description |

## Enumerations

### `HandlePerms` { #handleperms }

Permissions enum for an object.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PERM_WAIT` | `1` | This handle can be used for a WaitOn(). |
| `PERM_SEND` | `2` | Object with this handle can be Signal()led or Call()ed. |
| `PERM_TXFR` | `4` | Object with this handle can be granted to others. |
| `PERM_MAP` | `8` | Object with this handle can be mapped into the Space. |
| `PERM_CNTL` | `16` | Object with this handle's permissions can be altered. |
| `PERM_WRITE` | `32` | Object with this handle can be mapped writable. |
| `PERM_EXEC` | `64` | Object with this handle can be mapped executable. |
| `PERM_ALL` | `127` | Object with all permissions. |

### `ZuzuObjectCode` { #zuzuobjectcode }

Type enum for Create() and Query().

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OBJECT_TASK` | `0` | This handle names a Task object. |
| `OBJECT_SPACE` | `1` | This handle names a Space object. |
| `OBJECT_PORT` | `2` | This handle names a Port object. |
| `OBJECT_EVENT` | `3` | This handle names an Event object. |
| `OBJECT_MEMORY` | `4` | This handle names a Memory object. |
| `OBJECT_CODE_COUNT` | `5` | [ZuzuObjectCode](#zuzuobjectcode) enum has this many items. |

### `CreateMemoryFlags` { #creatememoryflags }

Flags enum for Create().

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `MEM_CONTIG` | `1` | This memory is physically contiguous. |
| `MEM_UNCACHED` | `2` | This memory is not cacheable. |
| `MEM_FLAGS_ALL` | `3` | Both flags are OR'ed. Useful for DMA buffers. |

### `DmaDir` { #dmadir }

Direction enum for DMA memory operations.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `DMA_TO_DEVICE` | `1` | This Memory is read from a DMAC and sent to the device. |
| `DMA_FROM_DEVICE` | `2` | This Memory is written to by a DMAC and read from the device. |
| `DMA_BIDIRECTIONAL` | `3` | This Memory can be read from and written to by a DMAC. |

### `TaskWaitOutcome` { #taskwaitoutcome }

Status code of a task that was being waited on.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TASK_EXITED` | `0` | The task exited voluntarily. |
| `TASK_FAULTED` | `1` | The task faulted, freezing every other Task in the Space. |

### `DmaSyncOp` { #dmasyncop }

DmaSync operation verb.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `DMA_SYNC_FOR_DEVICE` | `0` | Make the device synchronize. |
| `DMA_SYNC_FOR_CPU` | `1` | Make the CPU synchronize. |

### `EventType` { #eventtype }

Event type to bind to a bit of an event.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `EVENT_MEMMGMT` | `1` | Physical memory running low. |
| `EVENT_IRQ` | `2` | Hardware interrupt. |
| `EVENT_PORT` | `3` | Call()ed on port, used to multiplex. |
| `EVENT_TASK` | `4` | A task died. |
| `EVENT_SPACE` | `5` | A space is hollowed out. |

### `MemProt` { #memprot }

Permission bits for memory objects.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PROT_READ` | `1` | Read permission. |
| `PROT_WRITE` | `2` | Write permission. |
| `PROT_EXEC` | `4` | Execute permission: cannot be use with Write. |

Query operation code.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `QUERY_TYPE` | `0` | Query the type of object this handle is referring to. |

| `QUERY_DMA_DIR` | `9` | Query the DMA direction for this object. |

ManageHandle operation code.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `MNGHNDL_DUPLICATE` | `0` | Duplicate this object to a new handle. |
| `MNGHNDL_RESTRICT` | `1` | Reduce the permissions of this object. |
| `MNGHNDL_CLOSE` | `2` | Drop the handle to this object, destroy if no one is referencing it. |
| `MNGHNDL_QUERY` | `3` | Query this object. |
| `MNGHNDL_DESTROY` | `4` | If owned by the caller, destroy this object fully. |
| `MNGHNDL_GRANT` | `5` | Grant this object to a kitten. |
| `MNGHNDL_IRQ_REARM` | `6` | Re-arm an interrupt of this device. |

### `ManageTaskVerb` { #managetaskverb }

ManageTask operation code.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `MNGTASK_START` | `0` | Start a created task. |
| `MNGTASK_KILL` | `1` | Kill an owned task. |
| `MNGTASK_SET_PRIORITY` | `2` | Change the priority of the caller or an owned task. |
| `MNGTASK_SET_MAX_PRIO` | `3` | Change the max. priority of the caller or an owned task |
| `MNGTASK_SET_TIMESLICE` | `4` | Change the timeslice of the caller or an owned task. |
| `MNGTASK_SUSPEND` | `5` | Suspend an owned task. |
| `MNGTASK_RESUME` | `6` | Resume an owned task. |

| `MNGTASK_SET_REGS` | `8` | Change the register frame of an owned task. |

## Structures

### `DmaMapArgs` { #dmamapargs }

Arguments required to map a DMA buffer.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `dev` | [`Handle`](#handle) | Device handle for the DMA buffer related to the device. |
| `mem` | [`Handle`](#handle) | Memory buffer to turn into a DMA buffer. Should be MEM_CONTIG \| MEM_UNCACHED. |
| `offset` | `size_t` | Byte offset into the memory object where the DMA window is. |
| `len` | `size_t` | Size of the DMA window. |
| `dir` | [`DmaDir`](#dmadir) | Direction of DMA. |

### `KickstartArgs` { #kickstartargs }

Arguments required to map a DMA buffer.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entry` | `void *` | Entry point for the Task. |
| `sp` | `void *` | Stack point for the Task. Must be mapped. |
| `r0` | `uint32_t` | First initial register value for the Task. |
| `r1` | `uint32_t` | Second initial register value for the Task. |

### `PortWaitResult` { #portwaitresult }

Return values for WaitOn on a port object.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | [`Err`](errors.md#err) | If the wait succeeded, returns ZUZU_OK. If the request was nonblocking and the wait timed out, it returns ERR_TIMEOUT. |
| `sender` | [`Marker`](#marker) | [Marker](#marker) assigned to the sender's port object. |
| `xlen` | `uint32_t` | Length of the message. |
| `granted` | [`Handle`](#handle) | [Handle](#handle) to a granted object in the receiver's table. |

### `EventWaitResult` { #eventwaitresult }

Return values for WaitOn on an event object.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | [`Err`](errors.md#err) | If the wait succeeded, returns ZUZU_OK. If the request was nonblocking and the wait timed out, it returns ERR_TIMEOUT. |
| `bits` | [`EventWord`](#eventword) | The word at the time of wakeup. |

### `TaskWaitResult` { #taskwaitresult }

Return values for WaitOn on a task object.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | [`Err`](errors.md#err) | If the wait succeeded, returns ZUZU_OK. If the request was nonblocking and the wait timed out, it returns ERR_TIMEOUT. |
| `outcome` | [`TaskWaitOutcome`](#taskwaitoutcome) | Why the task stopped. |
| `value` | `int32_t` | If exited gracefully, the task's return code. |

### `SpaceWaitResult` { #spacewaitresult }

Return values for WaitOn on a space object.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | [`Err`](errors.md#err) | If the wait succeeded, returns ZUZU_OK. If the request was nonblocking and the wait timed out, it returns ERR_TIMEOUT. |
| `exit_status` | [`Err`](errors.md#err) | The last task's return code. |

### `DmaMapResult` { #dmamapresult }

Return values for DmaMap.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | [`Err`](errors.md#err) | ZUZU_OK on success, negative on failure. |
| `bus_addr` | `uintptr_t` | Address as seen by the device. |
| `id` | `uint32_t` | ID of the mapping, for adoption. |

|---|---|---|
